maria (partnerships): Heads-up — Datadog kickoff scheduled next Tue. They want a bundled marketplace tile: quickstart, prebuilt dashboard JSON, and an OpenTelemetry integration guide. Can we lock sampling + dashboard list this week?

alex (eng-sre): Quick question — target sampling? 1% global is common but our traces are long for model inference.

jamal (eng-platform): For large models we should do tail-based sampling. Proposal: default sample 0.5% of traces, but force 100% for errors and any span >500ms. Add model.name/model.version/route as span attributes.

sasha (devex): I'll put together the quickstart (node + python) and an OTLP collector snippet. Plan: examples, env var guide, and a `dd` exporter config. Need to know exact span attributes to show.

maria (partnerships): Datadog asked for dashboard tiles: p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, inferred cost per 1k tokens, error rate, KV-cache hit%, active sessions, and a trace flamegraph for slow requests. They also want a one-click import JSON.

eldridge (marketing): We need a simple 1-pager for joint announcement + a screenshot. DD side asked: can we ship assets by Apr 5? Their marketplace slot is a week later.

alex (eng-sre): Ops checklist note — include runbook steps for traffic spike: 1) scale Dedicated pool, 2) enable fallback model (cheaper), 3) switch routing to regional instance, 4) enable KV cache warmers. I'll template the circuit-breaker config.

sasha (devex): Example OTLP collector snippet (for docs):
```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: 
      http: 
exporters:
  otlp/remote:
    endpoint: "api.datadoghq.com:4317"
    headers:
      DD_API_KEY: "<YOUR_KEY>"
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      exporters: [otlp/remote]
```
Will annotate with `service.name=redwood-inference`, `model.name`, `model.version`, `route`, and `cache.hit` tags.

maria (partnerships): Action items (owners & dates):
- sasha: quickstart + collector config + example projects by Fri (1799570000)
- alex: runbook + sampling perf tests by Tue (1799600000)
- jamal: Datadog dashboard JSON (one-click import) + metrics mapping by Wed (1799640000)
- eld ridge: announcement copy + screenshot coordination with DD by Fri (1799570000)

jamal (eng-platform): For the dashboard JSON I'll include template widgets for: latency histogram, trace flamegraph, tokens/sec timeseries, cost estimator (derived metric), error spikes, and KV-cache hit gauge. Will add recommended alert thresholds too.

tasha (dd-pdm): Thanks — on our side we can accept the one-click JSON and quickstart. If assets land by Apr 5 we can schedule the marketplace publish for Apr 8. Also request: add `env` and `region` tags so customers can filter.

deploy-bot: ci/redwood/observability-assets #324 passed (quickstart lint + dashboard schema) :white_check_mark:

alex (eng-sre): Noted re `env`/`region`. Also adding load-test harness to validate sampling config. Will share results in this thread.

maria (partnerships): Great. If everyone hits their dates we can proceed with DD publish and coordinated tweet/announce. I'll collect final assets on Apr 4 and do a dry-run import. :thumbsup:

sasha (devex): Copy — I'll post the quickstart repo link when ready and ping @maria.

tasha (dd-pdm): Looking forward to it. Open to a 30-min handoff call next Wed if helpful.

maria (partnerships): Let's do it. I'll schedule the call once we have dashboard draft. Thanks all.
